description: ENAPEQ crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C88 H98 Dy4 N16 O26 2+,2(C2 H3 O2 1-),5(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.648-3.683 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 91.17-104.16°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Dy4L4(OH)2](OAc)2·5H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
